page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Above it, a decorative headpiece (not transcribed). Below the title, the dedication heading and the author's name, then one dedicatory paragraph running to the foot. No margin notes. Below the text, a small gathering mark.

main_text.head: VIRO ILLVSTRISSIMO FRANCISCO AVGVSTO THVANO IACOBI AVGVSTI FILIO, CONSISTORIANO COMITI, ET LIBELLORVM SVPPLICVM IN REGIA MAGISTRO,
main_text.p: CVM animo mecum reputo ingentes illas, FRANCISCE AVGVSTE THVANE, VIR ILLVSTRISSIME, quasi in te, quasi hereditario iure collatas miramur, virtutes; cùm dignitatem amplissimam, te hac [illegible, ~9 letters] cōpellare, tenuitatis meae mihi probe conscius, & operae leuidensis, vix audeo: Eductus quippe atque educatus inter ipsos poene dixerim literarum hostes, non est quod sperem quicquam à me, quod aetatem ferat, in publicum edi posse: neque adeo me ipse amo, vt tibi probari hoc quicquid est libelli, quod nomini tuo, si pateris, VIR ILLVSTRISSIME, eo consecratum, confidam: [illegible, ~20 letters]. Verum animos mihi addidit, vt auderem, veneranda LEGVM, quarum syllogen do, & interpretationem facio, maiestas, & eorum, plerorumque certe, qui has condidere LEGES, sancti atque ad virtutem facti mores, & inclyta famâ gloria: maxime cum vnicè optarent domum tuam, tot tuorum imaginibus maiorum claram, adire, & ad te de suis referre LEGIBVS, quo maiori, imo certa cum spe earum ferendarum, tuae beati praeiudicio sententiae, illas promulgent, ac litera-

page.notes: Greek text in the first paragraph (after "te hac") and at the end of the first paragraph (after "confidam:") is too blurred to read; both are marked illegible. The drop cap "C" with "VM" forms "CVM". The word "quasi in te" is tightly spaced in the scan and may read "quasin te". The line-end hyphen in "litera-" continues on the next page. The gathering mark below the text is uncertain.
